declarations.name: DkMath.CosmicFormula.GTail_rec
declarations.statement:

    {R : Type _} [CommSemiring R]
    (d r : ℕ) (x u : R) (hr : r < d) :
    GTail d r x u =
      (Nat.choose d r : R) * u ^ (d - r) + x * GTail d (r + 1) x u

  DkMath.CosmicFormula.GTail d r x u = ↑(d.choose r) * u ^ (d - r) + x * DkMath.CosmicFormula.GTail d (r + 1) x u
